audit.scope: Read-only coverage-boundary audit of the 48-entry 00:D277 directory, main text groups 32..47, menu groups 0/1/2/8, name groups 16..26, and literal residue in text banks.
method: Read the D277 3-byte directory and pointer tables.
Parsed entries with source/vendor/native_parser.py and compared against work/zcode-menu/input.json, work/name-contracts.json, work/text-graph/graph.json, and work/zcode-control-audit/out.
Scanned for FF-terminated Japanese runs in gaps not covered by known literals/tables.
Disassembled 00:C7CD-00:C874 to confirm the menu table selector and default glyph rendering.
limitations: Group 2 F7 operands are opaque and were not treated as text.
The standalone-table scan was targeted, not exhaustive.
Table lengths are layout bounds, not per-consumer proofs.
Parallel products work/zcode-extra-menu and work/zcode-extra-names appeared during this audit; they were consulted read-only to avoid reporting already-covered text as missing.

extra_menu.scope: pure glyph/F3/FF roots; native F5/F6/FC/FD/FE controls excluded

extra_names.scope: 14 item names from the independent 16-slot table; translated but not integrated at audit time

mixed_menu.scope: glyph runs split around F5/F6/FC/FD/FE/FF; translation pending at audit time

build_integration.conclusion: As of graph-009, the build accepts zcode-bulk-01..09 and the original 239 menu literals; it does not contain the parallel extra-menu, mixed-menu, or extra-names ids. Translation existence therefore does not yet imply integration.

directory.conclusion: Every non-zero root is accounted for by a representative group; no distinct non-empty directory group is missing. Groups 3-7, 9-15, 21-22, 41-42 are aliases; 27-31 are zero.

renderer_evidence: 00:C7CD reads group from dp $01 and entry from dp $00; 00:C7D6-00:C7E1 computes group*3 and reads the 24-bit root at 00:D277.

00:C804 JSR 00:CD9E consumes one character; 00:C80B CMP #$00F0 BCS control path; 00:C810 CMP #$00E8 BCC 00:C84B; 00:C84B-00:C874 writes the glyph directly to the VRAM buffer. F4 is not required for default glyph rendering.
menu_group_text_without_F4.provable_range: All listed slots are D277 group table entries; each raw stream contains no F4 and decodes to a complete Japanese string; no literal span from work/zcode-menu/input.json overlaps the entry. The 13 remaining entries additionally contain F5/F6/FC/FD/FE or BLANK control bytes; they are split into glyph runs by work/zcode-mixed-menu/input.json.
menu_group_text_without_F4.unproven_range: Which screen/selection index invokes each entry; whether some entries are dead or overwritten at runtime. Table lengths remain layout upper bounds. The mixed-menu translations were not present when this audit ran, and neither extra pass is in graph-009.
